task.title: Apply a starter preset
task.shortdesc: Use a starter preset to seed common Firefox policy choices before detailed editing.

prereq.p: A profile draft is open in Step 1.

context.p: Starter presets provide a known baseline that you can still change in Guided editor, All settings, or JSON editor.

step.cmd: Open the starter preset area in Profile & baseline.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Compare the available presets against the profile scenario.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Apply the preset that matches the intended browser behavior.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review the changed summary before moving to the next step.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The draft contains the preset settings as a starting point.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a preset added unwanted settings, choose a different preset or reset the affected controls before saving.
